messages:
jess-support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting p99s spiking to ~12s for /v1/generate since ~09:30 UTC. Symptoms: long upstream queueing, requests stuck in 'admitted' queue then late ACKs from workers.

mike-sre: seeing the same in Datadog: ingress.queue.admit.depth up 4x, worker-latency.p99 jumping. Alert fired: dd:ingress/p99-latency.

dd-alerts-bot: [ALERT] ingress.queue.admit_depth > 500 for cluster-prod-us-west (09:32).

anya-runtime: checking worker pool metrics — group gpu-pool-3 started returning sporadic ACKs (timeouts) around 09:28. Kernel OOM events? I/O waits high on nodes 3/4.

lina-oncall: @mike-sre @anya-runtime can we temporarily increase admission concurrency and enable priority for internal health-checks and paid-tenants? Need quick mitigation while we investigate root cause.

mike-sre: on it. Increasing admission concurrency from 100 -> 200 for the next 10m on frontend ingress. Also opening a priority path for high-tier tenants. Pushing a config change now.

devops-bot: rolling update: ingress-config concurrency bumped to 200 (rev 2026a), priority-queue enabled for tag:tier=paid.

jess-support: customers reporting partial relief already (one said p99 down to 3s). Thanks. Still see some 10s tails.

anya-runtime: dug into worker logs — a flurry of retry storms after a billing-sync job at 09:25 caused many clients to replay ephemeral API keys; that amplified concurrent requests and triggered KV-cache thrashing. Example repro curl we used:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":64}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

When the token refresh returns 429s, clients aggressively retry without backoff.

mike-sre: root cause looks like a combination: billing sync caused short auth flaps -> clients retried -> admission queue overloaded -> slow KV cache evictions on workers -> late ACKs. Working fixes: 1) short-term: admission concurrency bump + priority queues (done), 2) add short randomized client-retry guidance in client SDK, 3) worker-side: tighten KV cache eviction threshold and force one rolling restart of gpu-pool-3 nodes.

lina-oncall: starting rolling restart of gpu-pool-3 now, one node at a time. ETA ~8m.

devops-bot: restart job initiated on nodes gpu-3a -> gpu-3b -> gpu-3c.

jess-support: CS updated customers with interim mitigation steps and asked them to upgrade SDK to include exponential backoff.

anya-runtime: after restart, late ACK rate dropped ~90%, queue depth normalized. Recommending a postmortem and adding a safeguard: if auth-backend returns >5% 429s in 1m, temporarily enable an admission reject policy with Retry-After header to encourage client backoff.

mike-sre: agreed. I'll draft a short runbook entry and a small server patch to return Retry-After + 503 on ingress when admitted depth > 600 to avoid pileups.

jess-support: perfect — filing escalation ticket with customer impact notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:

mike-sre: follow-ups: add SDK backoff guidance, patch ingress to emit Retry-After, automate priority-queue for paid tenants, postmortem tomorrow 10:00.

lina-oncall: closing the live incident thread; reopen if regressions observed.
